about: The framework symbols scripts/release/scan-ipa.mjs looks for in a built Automatos Go binary (US-021h, R07, KR12), each with the Info.plist key(s) App Store processing requires when a binary references it (ITMS-90683: the academy app's first upload bounced for PHAsset without NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription), and why. A referenced symbol needs every key in keys, each a non-empty string in the app's Info.plist; a forbidden symbol fails the scan whatever the plist holds. doc is the name docs/native-modules.md 'Symbols and usage keys' and docs/release/ios-usage-keys.json use when it differs from the bytes searched for. scripts/__tests__/release-scan-ipa.test.ts keeps this list in step with both.

symbols.reason: Reads photo library items; expo-image-picker, expo-file-system, expo-image-manipulator and expo-video reference it.
Photo library authorisation and changes; expo-image-picker and expo-file-system reference it.
Saves an image to the photo library, which needs the add-only key.

Add-only photo library access (expo-image-picker's MediaLibraryWriteOnlyPermissionRequester). An enum case: compiled code holds its value, not its name, so a byte search rarely sees it and a miss proves nothing; the notice key stays in app.json for that reason.

Camera and microphone capture (expo-camera, expo-image-picker, @livekit/react-native-webrtc and the LiveKitWebRTC pod). One class serves video and audio, and a byte search cannot tell which a binary uses, so both keys (docs/native-modules.md maps the class to both).
Asks for the microphone (AVAudioSession and AVAudioApplication selectors); expo-speech-recognition calls it.
The iOS 17 class that asks for and reports microphone permission.
Speech recognition; expo-speech-recognition (quick-ask) uses it.
Motion sensors; expo-camera and react-native-reanimated reference it.
Motion activity (walking, driving).
Step counting.
Location. No bundled module references it (docs/native-modules.md), so the app has no location key: a hit means a dependency brought it and a key and a new build are needed.
The address book. No bundled module references it.
Calendars and reminders (iOS 17 full-access key). No bundled module references it.
Face ID; expo-local-authentication (step-up) and expo-secure-store reference it.
The music library. expo-video imports MediaPlayer for MPNowPlayingInfoCenter and MPRemoteCommandCenter only.
Bluetooth. No bundled module references it.
Bluetooth advertising. No bundled module references it.
Health data.
NFC tag reading.
Bonjour browsing on the local network.
Bonjour browsing on the local network (the older API).

App Tracking Transparency (KR10: no tracking, no ATT, privacy label 'Tracking: No'). expo-speech-recognition imports the framework but uses no symbol from it, so a hit means tracking code reached the binary.
